challenge.better_approach: Fix the bash launcher's pid probe for MSYS: rejected, the bash file is slated for retirement (c3cd232ba0cf) and outline 10.3.2.1 makes the Python entry the one that matters.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That tmux tooth 5 passes on Linux against superclaude.py (it parses --tmux and asks tmux_has('cairn_cc_<n>')); read from source, not run, since this box has no tmux. A Linux box will measure it.
challenge.prior_art: Checked in-house: superclaude.py:91 _pid_alive already has an OpenProcess branch chosen by the system device's launch tool; ticket 15d5d434f336 only moved the host name. No new probe needed. Tester unran_only (device.py:319) is the not-run rule.
challenge.real_collision: None found: the bash launcher stays live on Linux and its retirement is a separate child of c3cd232ba0cf; this ticket does not touch it.

answers.falsifier: On akiendell the proof's teeth 1-4 pass and tooth 5 prints a FAIL line containing UNRAN; on a Linux box with tmux all 5 pass; with the proof's launcher swapped back to the bash file tooth 1 reds on akiendell.
answers.from_idea: none, because measured 2026-11-23 by running ticket 15d5d434f336's proofs natively on akiendell; see CairnCommons/tickets/15d5d434f336-the-cc-device-names-its-host-through-the-system-device-s-host-tool.json
answers.how: Proof-only edit: run superclaude.py through sys.executable instead of bash; stage the held and dead pids as sys.executable children; compare the flags home by Path equality; the tmux tooth raises 'UNRAN: ...'; the __main__ prints teeth through run_teeth so the reason reaches stdout.
answers.traces_to: Law 3 (nothing is known until measured) and Law 8 (a proof a hollow build couldn't pass): a proof that drives the wrong launcher or a shebang file on Windows measures the host, not the code; outline 9.4.8.1 (a tooth this host cannot run reads not-run, never red); outline 10.3.2.1 (superclaude is Python on every box)
answers.what: The proof test_a_launch_moves_off_a_held_instance.py measures the Python launcher cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py on every OS, and its tmux tooth reads UNRAN where tmux is absent.

bullets.text: Measured 2026-11-23: the Python launcher already moves a second `cairn superclaude` off a held instance on Windows (launching 1); only the bash launcher the proof drove stayed on 0. The proof was wrong, not the launcher.
